The '''Vagneria system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] known as the [[Vagnerian canapé]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|290|Vagnerian canapé}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Vagnerian canapé]]|system=Vagneria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagneria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA" />
